notes.title: 1 day to go: announcing a FREE Deluxe Set!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32460677/da07cc05234ee69ce5377cdadda773645c96ccea.jpg

Important notice regarding the Deluxe Set 

Since we are delaying the release of the comic book by 1 day, the Deluxe Set giveaway will continue until Monday (October 15th) and not tomorrow (October 11th), as originally planned. This should give players ample time to make sure they’ve got the deluxe content (art book, OST, comic book) copied from [code]C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Insomnia The Ark\Insomnia_v2\Content[/code] to another location on their hard disk before these items are gone from their original folder.

Original Post 

Hello everyone! Just 1 day left until INSOMNIA: The Ark releases on Steam and other stores, so we’ve prepared two very, very special announcements to make this affair even sweeter. One for today and one for tomorrow ;)

As a thank you for your continued enthusiasm and passion for the game, everyone who buys INSOMNIA: The Ark during the first 2 weeks of launch (September 27th - October 11th) will get the Deluxe Edition instead of the regular one! After this period, the Deluxe Edition will be distributed with an appropriate price tag, so this is your chance to get it for free.

What's so special about this game edition you may ask? Let’s find out!

Digital Art Book

INSOMNIA: The Ark - is not just a game, but a whole world that our team has lived in all of these years, trying to create something unique, something that can take the life of its own. The game became noticed by fans for many reasons, but it is the setting and the art style that make it truly stand out.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32460677/2783bf6c7eba195f4d8413a44b419a6c8a7e4a49.png
To create a distinct visual style, we have studied hundreds of materials and references that include historical architectural plans, as well as prototypes of equipment and items from the early twentieth century.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32460677/560730f310eefc281b8665dc8d153712f894c3df.png

You can expect to see works made by such artists as Adrian Smith, Jan Vergen, Yong Yi Lee, John Lew, Alexandr Torchinov, Vasily Hazykov and other talented individuals who helped create a unique look for the game’s universe. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32460677/38e3d55209e70d355f0e0959ea05a6a3e515a134.png
This digital art book (pdf format) contains over 130 pages full of high quality concept art, sketches and models - everything that helped create such a cruel, yet attractive world of INSOMNIA: The Ark.

Digital Comic Book

Delve into the story of Thyper - the infamous mercenary also known as the Bane of Mills, whom you might remember from the Prologue chapter of INSOMNIA: The Ark. This issue of the comic (pdf format) contains pages packed with action and backstory that introduce readers to some of the key characters that appear in the actual game. Who are they? What is the motivation behind their actions? There’s only one way to find out…

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32460677/583a15783e1876f93f69c716c2477fc673d6efb4.png
Please note that the comic book will become available on October 11th in the form of a Steam update.

Original Soundtrack

It’s not a secret that music plays a very important role in helping create games with rich atmosphere. INSOMNIA’s OST is no exception to that rule. 12 ambient tracks (mp3, 320 kbps) inspired by the very best (Mark Morgan, Vangelis, Gustavo Santaolalla, Max Richter, Brian Eno) and brought to you by the incredibly talented Textere Oris will provide you with perfect company both inside and outside the game. Here’s a quick sample:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32460677/cb47ac7caa40cd8e777d47d85c00d341e6a2803e.png

Exclusive in-game item set

Object 6 is no place for a picnic. You have to keep your eyes open at all times to stay alive. However, centuries of living in such harsh conditions has taught locals a thing or two about survival. One of them was Dalok - a famous adventurer, a thief and an artificer known for his many inventions. His equipment always had the perfect balance of strength, convenience and functionality. Even years after Dalok is no longer with us, you can still enjoy this unique set of equipment that includes:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32460677/baae3022db18c501fc6a321486eb50569d1dad5e.png

 Dalok's Jacket, Leggings & Pack - made of rakh hide fortified with thin armor plates and a plethora of hidden pockets and fasteners.

 Eyon Helmet - this piece of equipment is a part of an outfit used by space shuttle pilots. Gear like this is a true rarity in the Near Range.

 Hansen Electric Saw - part of a limited series that was made available in the second century after the Exodus. Thanks to a titanium disc, this weapon can pierce even through medium-grade armor. The legendary killer Blister, with a head count of more than 150 victims, is often depicted using this kind of electric saw.

ATTENTION: You will be able to find this armor set next to your personal locker in the Vulture’s Nest.

So what’s next?

INSOMNIA: The Ark will launch tomorrow September 27th @ 8pm GMT+3 / 10:00 PDT / 13:00 EDT, followed by our next special announcement. The launch will also be accompanied by a live stream on our Steam page! Come share the moment with us :)

notes.title: The Nomah Autonomy’s Guide to Object 6

Hey there, traveler! So, you were lucky enough to get invited (or sneak) aboard Object 6 and survive the nuclear apocalypse? Say no more! Let us show you around this magnificent vessel and check out the best spots for all types of passengers. No worries, there’s enough time to see everything. After all, we’ve been traveling for 412 years already!

Facts to consider before waking up from the Big Sleep

Object 6 is a megalithic interplanetary station created for the colonization of remote star systems. Behold a multi-level metropolis with fully autonomous life support systems that are capable of accommodating up to 10 million colonists. The station was designed for the long haul, with the aim of allowing its inhabitants to be fully self-sustained.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32460677/c3691c238f6a84f58ae827bc08acc93f48b4fcc4.jpg
The official maps show just over half of the available sectors. Exploring the rest of the station has proved to be challenging due to rubble, floods and the overall damage sustained from bombing during the Last War. 

Currently, Object 6 is home to about 1.5 million people, of whom 600,000 are located in Urb and 900,000 in the Near Range and Junkyard. 

Destination #1 - Urb

The Nomah Autonomy was established several years after the Exodus. Urb - an isolated, autonomous sector became the capital of the official authority. A proper stronghold, it is the most secure and well-developed part of the station. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32460677/eb5c9fb7d2d31a117a7146782d39e83fb274ae96.png
During the first forty years after the Exodus, Urb was ruled by Prime-General Azar, who established a military dictatorship. By this time, the station’s resources were almost depleted and Azar had to enforce a strict birth control policy. Soon after, a complete ban on childbearing came into effect. 

From this point onwards, new citizens of Urb all came to life in the Incubator. Genetic adjustment programs help newborns adapt to the station’s living conditions and, if you believe official propaganda, prevent a psychological disease called “somnia”. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32460677/4e7472a26b7769accf878427e9364f46ce1a7182.png
Despite the prohibitions, some Urbanites have secretly started families outside of Urb, mostly in the reservations inhabited by ghetters (descendants of illegal refugees). Still, Urb is arguably the best place to be during your stay on Object 6!

Destination #2 - Near Range

The Near Range is a vast territory around Urb controlled by the Nomah Autonomy. Important facilities are located here and thus, a permanent military presence is required. The Near Range is inhabited by ghetters, who prefer the relative safety of the half-abandoned tunnels to the unpredictable, often perilous life in the Junkyard.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32460677/5c2f3e01dca0bf96abe48beffe6a3a1c1c6d59ef.png
Despite the high number of military outposts, it is easy to stumble upon a band of marauders or a pack of aggressive creatures — they usually dwell in the lower levels and move closer to transport routes in search of prey. These minor inconveniences aside, if you are a ghetter wise to the way things work around here, Near Range is going to feel like home.

Destination #3 - Junkyard

The Junkyard consists of vast unexplored territories outside the Near Range and is home to deformants and junkster gangs. Absolute anarchy reigns supreme, and living conditions are not suitable for anyone with plans for their body parts being intact. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32460677/b6f6fc5bdc554e2d4e8582cef7895d3ab33f361f.png
Workers that have received a work visa and are able to find employment in Urb are considered prosperous. They present a caricature for what passes as higher middle class in the Junkyard. Many infamous criminal clans claim this territory as their home. Some of these gangs have ties and history that date back to the Exodus itself. But that's a whole different story…

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32460677/1c650b5004dbab5f0effa25b0b0d0b4c885488dd.png
P.S. We hope you enjoyed this travel guide, and remember - everyone can find the right place for themselves on Object 6! See you soon on our interplanetary space metropolis on September 27th!

notes.title: The Exodus - from the ashes of despair spread the wings of hope
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32460677/cbec25c4f6b21827fd059dabe2f295a4f7a9bcdf.png
Hello everyone! As you may know, INSOMNIA’s story begins on Object 6 - a giant space metropolis that has been on its way to the mysterious Evacuation Point for more than 400 years. 

You may wonder how and why the people of Nomah ended up in such a situation in the first place. Fear not, our latest lore entry is here to bring you the answers ;)

Home planet

The story of the Nomah nation starts on Teina Nui - a name give by the ancients to their home planet with two bright suns shining high above it. Many centuries have passed before the Nomans united vast territories under their banner, establishing the greatest country that ever existed — the United Nomah Hierarchy.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32460677/5673932284f1906480b3dff0df586fc7bfccc709.png
The age of the Hierarchy became the most fruitful era in the history of human civilization. Nonetheless, an empire of such colossal proportions could not remain undisturbed for long. A political bloc with heavy ties to the military called SORG had formed in the northern dominion, quickly gaining influence and announcing its independence soon after. Fearing the loss of hegemony, the Hierarchy struck first.

The Last War

This was the beginning of the Last War, which became the longest and biggest conflict humankind had ever endured. Millions of lives have been sacrificed; the planet was on the edge of an environmental catastrophe. Glaciers began covering ruined cities when the last Hierarchy stronghold fell.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32460677/874ba0dc2cdb3d0b3550d1c66ccb210928680ba5.png
Towards the end of the war, SORG held a technological advantage. They have introduced golems — giant battle machines that were made from soldiers with heavily modified bodies. Golems were remarkable warriors that held no pity for the enemies of the SORG regime. They lacked the flaws of human infantry - fear was unknown to these creatures; they didn’t need to eat, sleep or rest either. The Hierarchy had no choice - the only way to stop the golems was total nuclear annihilation. The land of Teina Nui turned into piles of radioactive ash and the fate of the Nomah nation was sealed.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32460677/117b6576505ec5cb00c1e4d68e44fd2cac214e2f.png

When the disastrous outcome of the war became clear, one of Hierarchy’s veterans, general Azar, sent the remnants of his army to northern shores. Their goal was to secure Object 6 — a megalithic interplanetary station, also known as the Ark, that was part of a colonization project predating the war. Abandoned and scarred by orbital bombardment, the station spent many long years at rest in an inconspicuous valley not far from a city called Taloi.

The Exodus

The news about the upcoming evacuation had spread with incredible speed. Thousands of people flocked to a ruined Taloi suburb with hope of salvation. Despite strict control measures taken by the army, many of the fleeing refugees managed to sneak aboard Object 6. The station, controlled by an autonomous navigation system, left the orbit of Teina Nui and headed towards the Evacuation Point — a distant planet where the Nomans hoped to start a new life.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32460677/253478065b4cf3588d858fcda12b6083a5e7c5e9.jpg
The Nomah nation was saved from the mechanized legions of the SORG regime, but the situation aboard Object 6 was getting worse every day. The army occupied Urb - an isolated sector containing most of the station’s supplies and resources. Hundreds of thousands of evacuees outside of Urb were left in the darkness of abandoned hallways. Famished and sick, no longer visually resembling humans, these people began to huddle together in packs, desperately fighting for a semblance of life. 

400 years later, the situation hasn’t changed drastically. That is, until your character, citizen KZ0012, recovers from a long-term stasis known as the Big Sleep. Riots in reservations, large-scale terrorist attacks — this is only a tip of the giant pile of problems that you will encounter on your journey. 

Your life, and the lives of Object 6’s inhabitants, is about to change… on September 27th.

notes.title: Hungry or unconscious - the philosophy behind the Big Sleep
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32460677/257edc3e6929d8a5041a0fb445561cecf348895d.png
Many a RPG world has broken down when simple questions, such as "how do these people survive in such conditions?" or "where do their get their food from?" are asked. Not in INSOMNIA’s case :). Today we reveal some more of the game’s lore to help you better understand the complex world that you will get to interact with.

The Big Sleep

Despite the fact that resource management was a priority for Object 6’s administration, the station’s production capacities were unable to fully supply the population with food. The problem was finally solved with the help of the Big Sleep procedure, which allowed citizens to spend from 5 to 10 years in stasis, depending on their status and qualifications. A colossal repository of delta modules called Limb was created, where three quarters of the station’s official population were suspended in cryosleep.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32460677/cf3e57c73d43dc61109a146643f43caf08e306f6.png
But what about those unfortunate souls that managed to sneak onto the station illegally and couldn’t be a part of the Big Sleep program? How did they survive without access to regular food supplies?    

Crioma

The abandoned sectors of the station have been populated with the descendants of illegal refugees over the course of years. The only way for them to survive was stealing, killing and practicing cannibalism. With time, they have also discovered crioma - a plant that could spread across the station’s tunnels and various sections at incredible pace, mutating constantly and producing "fruits" of various shapes and with strange properties. 

Eventually, these illegal refugees learned to consume crioma as food and use the plant as raw material for a large number of goods. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32460677/9506ee01b3092d29d78ac6638fb4823401d20993.jpg

After Object 6’s officials became aware of the "wonder-plant", it was discovered that crioma was developed prior to the war as an experimental food product able to survive in a variety of conditions. The genetic basis of crioma was algae and several moss species. 

How exactly the mutated crioma colonies have spread throughout the station remains unknown to this day. The wild culture quickly adapted to harsh conditions and developed a number of adaptive mechanisms - in particular, it began to reproduce by toxic volatile spores, hazardous to humans. Those working at the Cleaning Service’s border brigades are tasked with destroying the spreading crioma sprouts every day.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32460677/2706f96903df7aa801aada5496fbcfd6ed300072.jpg
The long term effects of crioma’s toxicity was also believed to cause Schizophreniform Anar’s disorder - a mental illness also known as “somnia”. The main symptoms of this disease include psychosis, impaired perception and emotional distress. However, somnia still plagued the population of the station even after the plant breeders of Object 6 managed to create a safe analogue of the plant called "oma". 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32460677/dc360314a257715528b2a67c3afd643353676099.gif
Was crioma’s toxic influence the real reason behind somnia? Or was it a more complex problem hidden by the officials of the space metropolis? You will have to embark on an epic journey later next month with INSOMNIA: The Ark to find the answers...

You can’t imagine how nervous we were when the beta keys were finally sent. It’s been two years since the last time we’ve shown actual gameplay.

The current beta has generated lots of feedback that has been useful in many ways. Thanks to your bug reports and suggestions in the Community Hub we now have a better idea on what needs to be fixed and/or improved in the first place. Expect an update to the beta build approximately next week with the following improvements:

 additional English localisation (item names and descriptions anyone?) 
 FPS cap removed 
 in-game settings save properly now 

We were also able to fix around 30 additional bugs that players have submitted so far, including those related to game save/load problems, crashes and the crafting system.

All of these improvements were possible thanks to your feedback, so keep it coming! We are still VERY interested in receiving bug reports and comments about each and every aspect of INSOMNIA. Stay tuned for future updates!
